decisions.reason: Providing the Apollo browser-extension link does not change how HubSpot lead lists are created or categorized.
The Apollo extension configuration does not alter HubSpot custom properties, tags, lead stages, or lead categories.
The source does not change the requirement to include notes for HubSpot leads.
Installing or linking the Apollo extension does not necessarily change the HubSpot lead-nurturing workflows.
The Apollo extension configuration does not alter HubSpot lead-task assignment behavior.
The source configures an Apollo-specific browser extension and does not change the existing HubSpot CRM setup requirement.
The Apollo browser extension is independent of MeetAlfred account configuration.
The Apollo browser-extension link does not change the Zapier account configuration requirement.
The extension may support getting leads into Apollo, but the source does not change the enrichment provider, target, data, or automatic enrichment mode.
The transfer path already runs through Apollo, and merely providing the Apollo extension link does not necessarily change the path, transfer steps, automation, or arrival time.
The Apollo extension does not alter the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization or its Zapier integration method.
The Apollo browser-extension configuration does not change automated email campaign behavior in MeetAlfred.
